# Premier Logistics Group (UK)

Premier Logistics Group (UK) is a Truck Transportation company. Premier Logistics Services is a leading logistics company in the UK that provides logistics services throughout the country. They offer a wide range of services including palletised distribution, contract logistics, warehousing, flat bed transportation, food & packaging, premier fleet services, mot preparation, vehicle inspections, vehicle servicing, and truck wash. Premier Logistics Group (UK) employs 31 people (+24.0% YoY, +6 people), founded in 2004. Headquartered in United Kingdom.

## About

At Premier Logistics we pride ourselves on quality. We specialise in palletised distribution, warehousing, Irish distribution and innovative solutions to the construction industry.

Our business aim is to give our customers an unrivalled experience building on our reputation of honesty and integrity.
